newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PAPIN FEELS HE IS BACK TO HIS BEST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PAPIN FEELS HE IS BACK TO HIS BEST.

text.p: Jean-Pierre Papin feels in top form for the first time since his return to France last summer and is keen to stay at Bordeaux for at least one more season.
"I had to recover from an injury of 14 months," said Papin on the eve of Bordeaux's first division match against Paris St Germain at Parc des Princes.

"I have been gaining strength little by little to get to full form. But that seems normal to me to get back to this standard. It was a question of time," said the 33-year-old ex-Marseille striker who joined Bordeaux last August.

Few people thought former France captain Papin, capped 54 times, could return to his lethal best when he topped the French league scorers' list for several successive seasons as a Marseille player after disappointing, injury-plagued spells abroad with AC Milan and Bayern Munich.

"I'm a long way from being close to retirement, although I realise it will be soon. On the contrary, I hope to play for another year or even two if eveything goes well. And at Bordeaux, of course," he said.
Papin had arguably his best match since returning to France in Bordeaux's 2-1 home win over Lens on Wednesday when he scored his side's equaliser, his 13th goal in the league this season.
Having also scored boths goals in Bordeaux's 2-0 win over champions elect Monaco two weeks ago, Papin is European Cup Winners' Cup finalists PSG's principal worry on Saturday.

"We're playing against a team that won a European cup final, that will play another European cup final and I think that will be a good test for us," said Papin, scorer of two goals against PSG in November.
